American Horror Story is BACK and Azucar's throwing the kickoff party it deserves. 😱📺 Murder House meets Coven energy takes over the Main Floor for AHS Season 13 — and we're not just watching, we're turning it into a full Spooktacular with a mini drag show hosted by Jayme right after the episode. Free entry. Free chills. All the tea, all the terror. This is the one you tell people you were at when it started — and heads up, we're doing this EVERY Thursday after for the next episode, so get in early before the coven claims your seat. 🕯️🔪 Bring your friends, bring your questions about what just happened on screen, and definitely bring cash for the queens because tips keep the magic alive. Horror fans, drag lovers, and everyone in between — this crossover was made for you.

📅 Thursday, September 24 — Doors 6PM, Episode 7PM, Drag Show After
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
💵 Free entry (tips for queens)
🔞 21+

The lights go down, the screen flickers on, and Azucar goes full haunted house. 🕸️🖤 Picture it: a room full of people gasping at the same jump scares, glasses clinking in the dark, red and black smoke curling off the stage as the episode wraps and the mini drag show creeps in right behind it. Jayme's hosting the Spooktacular, the energy is equal parts campy and creepy, and the whole night feels like stepping into your own AHS episode. Fishnets, fangs, and fabulousness collide the second those house lights come back up. It's the kind of Thursday that makes you forget it's a weeknight — sensory overload in the best way. Come for Murder House and Coven nostalgia, stay for the drag chaos that follows. 🩸💅

Mark your calendar — American Horror Story Season 13 kicks off at Azucar and it's a whole event. 🗓️📺 Murder House meets Coven, watched together, capped off with a mini Spooktacular drag show hosted by Jayme. Here's the breakdown: doors open at 6PM, the episode rolls at 7PM, and the drag show follows right after. Entry is free — just bring cash to tip the queens who close out the night. This isn't a one-and-done either: Azucar's doing this every Thursday going forward for the next episode, so if you miss this one, you've got more chances, but why wait? 21+ to get in.
